_help: Generated by tools/gen_tree.ps1 (edit that, then run it). starts = class -> start node (free for that class). Types: start, small, notable, key (keystone), hub. Mods use the stat keys in docs/STATS.md.

flags.cleave: Power attacks and combo finishers strike every enemy around you.
flags.multi: Bows loose three arrows at once, each for 55% damage.
flags.pierce: Arrows and magic bolts pass through enemies.
flags.manaShield: 35% of damage you take is paid from your mana first.
flags.undying: Once every 3 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 30% health instead.
flags.rage: You deal up to 50% more damage per point the more health you are missing.
